messages:
Ben (sales): Quick sync: HeliumHealth wants a 48h POC next week. They asked for a clear throughput handoff, autoscale policy JSON, preheat runbook, and security checklist answers.
Tara (solutions): Request profile? burst length, qps, token size?
Ben (sales): Baseline ~65 qps, short bursts up to ~230 qps for 2-6m. Typical completion ~95 tokens. Minimal embeddings.
Ivy (infra): Proposal: reserved 5 GPUs to start, burst credits for +4 GPUs up to 3m; autoscale threshold -> spin to 10 if sustained. Triggers: queued_requests & p95_latency.
Ravi (sre): Recommend burst-credit-first for <180s spikes to avoid cold containers. Add eviction tolerance doc for spot fallback.
Luz (security): Security quick answers: Dedicated supports VPC peering/private deploy, customer KMS, SOC2 Type II, audit logs (retention add-on), console IP allowlist, SSO (SAML/OIDC). Send questionnaire PDF and I'll draft.
Ben (sales): PDF: https://heliumhealth.example.com/sec-q.pdf Also they want admin-role mapping + SSO notes.
Tara (solutions): Pricing/quant note: redwood-14b-q8 gives ~+25% throughput; we can offer a reserved-commit discount for quant variants. If they go 100% quant we may need +1 GPU to hit identical p95 in some kernels -> will call out.
Ivy (infra): Preheat runbook snippet to hand off:
- Deploy canary variant to reserved pool
- Seed top-50 prompts to KV cache
- Run synthetic warmer @10 qps for 10m
- Check kv_cache_hit_rate >=60% and p95 latency
- If p95 > target -> add 1 GPU
Ben (sales): Can someone paste the autoscale JSON we can share with their infra team?
Ivy (infra): Autoscale JSON (hand-off): {"autoscale": {"min_reserved": 5, "max_reserved": 10, "scale_step_secs": 30, "burst_credit_threshold_secs": 180, "metrics": ["queued_requests", "p95_latency"]}}
DeployBot: Scheduled helium_poc_smoke for 2026-04-20T16:00:00Z. Report will be posted here. :robot_face:
Ravi (sre): I'll attach SLA notes and an eviction tolerance table to the final deliverable. Luz (security): I'll post the draft answers by EOD tomorrow. Ben (sales): Thank you — I'll loop legal once security draft is in. :thumbsup:
